title: MGI Easy Nucleic Acid Extraction Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: MGI Easy Nucleic Acid Extraction Kit
Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the OT‑2 deck according to the provided map, placing a Magnetic Module with an empty 96‑well deepwell plate, a NEST 1‑Well Reservoir (195 mL), a NEST 12‑Well Reservoir (15 mL), tip racks for the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette, and the 96‑well plate that contains the samples.

steps.title: Upload custom labware (if needed)
steps.instruction: If any labware is not in the OT‑2 library, upload its custom definition before running the protocol.

steps.title: Load protocol into OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: Upload the MGI Easy Nucleic Acid Extraction protocol file to the OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.21.0 or later).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the tip racks, all plates, reservoirs, and the P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette according to the standard calibration procedure.

steps.title: Add lysis mix
steps.instruction: Dispense the lysis mix into each well of the empty deepwell plate on the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Transfer samples and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer the samples from the 96‑well sample plate into the corresponding wells containing lysis mix and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Perform three wash steps
steps.instruction: Execute three consecutive wash steps as defined in the kit protocol, washing the bound nucleic acid on the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Carry out the elution step and transfer 75 µL of eluate from each well to a clean plate.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to execute the automated extraction.
